verdict.rationale: Omarchy is an opinionated Arch Linux desktop distribution, not a hosted service that emits events to registered HTTP endpoints, so webhook subscriptions are a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it shipping registrable outbound HTTP callbacks; its CLI, agent integrations and desktop notifications are not webhooks, and the probes found no API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
